name: What drywall thickness for walls vs ceilings?

mainEntity.name: What drywall thickness for walls vs ceilings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Walls: 1/2"; ceilings: 5/8" for sag resistance; garages/fire-rated use 5/8" Type X everywhere.
